item.title: Judge Quotes George Orwell’s 1984 in Order to Restore Slavery Exhibits
item.description: A judge ordered Interior Secretary Doug Burgum on Monday to restore a slavery-related exhibit at the President’s House in Independence National Historical Park in Philadelphia. Burgum ordered the National Park Service last month to remove the Philadelphia exhibit at the former residence of President George Washington, which still contains remains of the quarters in which he held enslaved Black people. item.title: Civil Rights Groups Sue to Protect Georgia Voter Data Seized by FBI
item.description: The federal government is being sued by civil rights organizations to protect voter data seized by the FBI in a raid at a Fulton County, Georgia, elections building last month.
